limitations: Diagnostic authored WP05 overfit prefixes, not held-out evaluation or a benchmark quality claim.
Token equality for stochastic fixtures does not guarantee arbitrary near-tie/filter-boundary or cross-platform equality.
Generation supports scalar physical RoPE offset, not arbitrary per-row custom position histories or external cache continuation.
Last sampled token is not forwarded; cache is private to the call and not returned.
Acceptance hooks copy logits to CPU; these probes are not latency or VRAM measurements.
Baseline context remains 1024; no silent context expansion or eviction.
remaining_phases: WP06.5 measured TTFT/latency/throughput/VRAM L=128/512/1024/2048 with explicit sufficient context configuration
